card_title: Apps like Dazz Cam for iPhone
card_summary: Camera-first apps vs editors: what to use when you want the Dazz look on your camera roll.
quick_answer: Dazz Cam is built around shooting: you pick a simulated camera and take a new photo. If you mostly shoot new photos, Dazz and apps like Huji or NOMO CAM fit. If you want the same old-camera look on photos already in your library, with aging, light leaks, a date stamp and one look on a whole set, use an editor such as Halatto.
intro: People look for apps like Dazz Cam for different reasons: the app is not on their phone, they want something different, or they want the look on photos they took earlier with the normal iPhone camera.
Here is how the options differ, so you can pick by what you actually do with your photos. We make Halatto, so read our part with that in mind.

faq.question: Is there a free app like Dazz Cam?
faq.answer: Most apps in this category are free to download with paid extras. Halatto is free to try: every look and effect works up to a daily limit, and a subscription or lifetime purchase removes the limit.

faq.question: Can I use a Dazz-style filter on photos I already took?
faq.answer: Yes, with an editor. In Halatto you open any photo from your library, including old ones and screenshots, and pick a camera look.

faq.question: Is Halatto affiliated with Dazz Cam?
faq.answer: No. Halatto is an independent app. Dazz Cam is named here only to describe the kind of look people search for.

faq.question: Is there an Android app like Dazz Cam from Halatto?
